purpose: Compare first BUSY with HIGH/HIGH after persistent-PE change to primary AS5600/STM32 documentation and firsthand reports

local_evidence.interpretation: No full >=3ms foreground starvation recorded before first failure. This does not exclude state sequencing, delayed handling of individual events, or electrical disturbance. Digital samples cannot prove line integrity.

code_checks.sensor: I2C1 AF4 PB8/PB9; HSI16 kernel; 0x30521317; ANF enabled and DNF2
code_checks.successful_read: PE kept enabled; CR2 cleared after completed STOP
code_checks.BERR: clear and continue per ES0431; separate diagnostic count

sources.finding: AS5600 is I2C target, no clock stretching, SCL is input; <50ns input-spike suppression; register-map/read sequence matches; VDD5V/VDD3V3 tied for3.3V mode; local bypass and pullups must match module topology. Sensor filtering/weak magnet must be separated from protocol failure.

Spurious BERR: clear/continue already implemented. Standard-mode kernel16MHz exceeds4MHz minimum. First-byte-stall APB/kernel1.5..3 condition absent at170/16=10.625. Do not infer F1 analog-filter BUSY erratum applies toG431.
Normal register-pointer write/repeated START/read and optional persistent pointer/read path. Generic Wire source is a protocol reference, not proof of immunity or a drop-in motor-safe replacement.
DIR must be defined. Existing module onboard bias unknown; four external wires do not establish DIR floating. Do not instruct blind grounding of outputs.

B-G431B-ESC1 AS5048B, additional AS5600 user15cm cable: observed marginal logic levels and ringing, changes to board-specific series/pullup network improved behavior. Author later corrected series value470R to47R. Different board: no direct resistor transplant toNucleo64.
AS5600 standalone okay, motor operation freezes readings; author resolved by replacing cable. Not proof our cable is defective.
Blocking Wire calls delay software motor-loop updates onG431 board. Our PWM isTIM1 hardware and I2C polling nonblocking; symptom must not be equated automatically.

ranked_unproven_hypotheses: Switching-related bus/ground/supply disturbance causes spurious protocol event and BUSY latch
I2C event sequencing/recovery bug exposed by PWM/ADC interrupt timing
Simple full foreground starvation >=3ms less supported by first snapshot; no shared PWM/I2C pins found

next_discriminating_check.goal: Separate firmware workload from energized inverter switching
next_discriminating_check.stage_A: Same TIM1/ADC and I2C workload with inverter switching physically disabled and independently confirmed discharged/off; evaluate digital bus and counters
next_discriminating_check.stage_B: Compare same code with energized switching only under separately authorized powered test
next_discriminating_check.instrument_limit: Saleae can expose logical protocol events in a deenergized setup, cannot prove analog rise time/ringing or measure HV-referenced bus without suitable isolation
